title: Only Sense Online
titleNative: オンリーセンス・オンライン-
synopsis: Utilizing a system called "Sense," each player aims to create their unique character in the VRMMORPG "Only Sense Online." Joining this realm is Yun, an absolute beginner in the world of gaming, equipped with some of the worst customized "Sense" ever. While his two sisters, both veterans in this world, criticize his choices of equipment, he continues to delve into the skill sets he has acquired. Along his way, he meets the art of "production" and people that have mastered this art. Watch as a total novice creates a revolution in the gaming world and create the "ultimate" support class.

title: Eko Eko Azaraku
synopsis: When the chant "Eko Eko Azarak" sounds something is bound to occur, be it within the town or the school! A classic horror manga, Eko Eko Azarak follows the witch Misa Kuroi ("Black Mass" in Japanese), and the various horrors she encounters during her travels. While relatively unknown outside of Japan the series was extremely well received domestically. It lasted for 19 volumes, spawned two sequels, an OVA, two TV series, six live action films and two video games. Included one-shot: Volume 19: Hitokui Ichizoku

title: Don Dracula
synopsis: After living in Transylvania for several years, "Earl Dracula" (as Osamu Tezuka's official website calls him in English) has moved to Japan. In the Nerima Ward of Tokyo, he and his daughter, Chocola, and faithful servant Igor have taken up residence in an old-Western style house. While Chocola attends Junior High School, Earl Dracula is desperate to drink the blood of beautiful virgin women; an appropriate meal for a vampire of his stature. However, each night that Earl Dracula goes out on the prowl he finds himself getting involved in some kind of disturbance which leads to him causing various trouble for the local residents. With nobody in Japan believing in vampires, his very presence causes trouble amongst the people in town. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

titleNative: ペリリュー～楽園のゲルニカ～
synopsis: Peleliu - Rakuen no Guernica follows the daily lives of Japanese soldiers taking part in the Battle of Peleliu during World War II: a high-casualty, months-long campaign. The main character, Tamaru, dreams of returning home to become a mangaka, and sees their island outpost as a wild paradise that can one day be used as a setting for one of his stories. Most of his comrades, however, are prepared for the more realistic scenario -- that they will not be leaving Peleliu alive. Note: Nominated to the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title: Inagaki Misao Horror M Senshuu
titleNative: 稲垣みさおホラーM選集
synopsis: A collection of Misao Inagaki's early oneshots from the Horror M magazine, known for extremely high quality horror manga and for its splatter horror series. Volume 1: Jisatsu-bu (自殺部) Jitsue is a second-year student who has just transferred to a new junior high. She wants to make friends as soon as possible, so she's glad when her classmate Chiaki invites Jitsue to come visit her club activity. But what happens when Jitsue finds out that the club is a “Suicide Club” that selects one person to commit suicide each month...! Volume 2: Kubitori Kanban (首取り看板) In addition to the title story, this horror anthology is filled with hair-raising scenes of terror! A dark story about Valentine's Day, and a gory incident at a school...? Volume 3: Nounai Chiryou: Brain Cure (脳内治療ブレーン・キュア) Shin Asakusa, a doctor who practices "brain cure" by entering directly into the brains of his patients to treat their psychological issues at the root of the problem. What is the fate of Shin and his patients who are lost in the maze of their brains?

title: How to Love a Loser
synopsis: Shinba has no talent, no job, no money...he's a complete loser. However, he has a girlfriend, Hizumi who is beautiful, smart, good at her work. He has no idea why she says she likes him. He's almost scared, but loves Hizumi so much...he asks Hizumi, "Why do you want to date with someone like me?" She answers..."You always oversleep, talk about some video games I don't even know about, sing lame songs no one knows at karaoke, gave me a toy ring as a gift. Your face is always gloomy as hell. But...looking at such face makes me happy, Shinba. I love you, ha ha." Is she telling the truth? Hizumi must have some kind of a secret, Shinba thinks. He wants to find out...but maybe he shouldn't. (Source: BookWalker)
